prompt: Three vertices of a rectangle are $(-1, 2)$, $(5, 2)$, and $(5, 6)$. What is the fourth vertex?
hint: In a rectangle, opposite sides have the same length.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Plot each number on a quick number line. Distances and order get obvious right away.
In a rectangle, opposite sides have the same length.
The missing vertex shares $x = -1$ with one vertex and $y = 6$ with another.

alternativeExplanations.title: Match opposite sides
steps: Top edge at $y = 6$ must also run from $-1$ to $5$.
